about_the_game:
NOTHING MATTERS.

A situational comedy horror adventure where nostalgia rots your soul.

You play as Donathan, a young orphan who stumbles into a cursed New York apartment building that once belonged to legendary comedian Gary Sinfeld. Years after Gary and his friends mysteriously vanished on Halloween night, 1994, the building has been left to decay.

Until Donathan returns, looking for shelter… and possibly the truth about his own twisted past.

Download the Prologue Demo today and be part of the chaos as we build a cinematic horror experience like no other.

Add to Wishlist now to help the development of Sinfeld: Evil Resident

Features

  • Deep Narrative

  • Open Exploration

  • Nightmarish Atmosphere

  • Adaptive Puzzles

  • Thought-Provoking Story

  • Haunting Soundtrack

  • Advanced Physics

  • New Revelations



    Note: Sinfeld: Evil Resident is a standalone experience that serves as a gateway into a larger, untold story. Download the demo to help us develop the full experience!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized horror violence, depictions of blood, suggestive themes, and frequent references to alcohol, drugs, and death. It also includes crude humor, surreal imagery, and depictions of ghostly possession. Player discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8750h
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard

short_description: You are Donathan, a comedian orphan trapped in the haunted apartment of your idol, now filled with rifts born from narcissism and spite. Will you muster the courage to crawl through those horrific butt holes and save what's left of your childhood hero's soul... or will their past consume you?
